objective: Operate a durable portrait-first source-to-verified-knowledge control loop.
hypothesis: A model portrait, exact capability planning, resource admission, and frozen verification prevent unsupported autonomous intervention.
falsification_criterion: The controller duplicates terminal work, bypasses portrait readiness, exceeds admitted resources, or promotes an unverified result.
selection_reason: The public package demonstrates the model-neutral control-plane contract without carrying local model or data bindings.

dataset.split_policy: screen and confirm remain frozen and independent
